column1: # The stages of the implementation of lesson P/01 (ADR-0126, addendum (1)): one possible order, a plan, not a norm. The norms are read in full
# by the rule of the implementer (the implementation README, «Inputs»); the advice is in the README, the checklist — «Done when».
# gate — <kind>:<argument>[:<argument>] without spaces: tests:<stage> — own tests of the implementation named after the stage; vectors:<package>
# — the vectors of the lesson through the vector command of the implementation; build — the build of the profile; accept:<chapter>:<scenarios|*>
# — the named scenarios of acceptance/<chapter>/scenarios.tsv (comma-separated) or * (all applicable) pass whole. A stage is closed when its

# gate and the gates of all former stages hold. weight — the relative weight 1–5; kit — the parts of kit B that close the stage, comma-separated: writecheck, door, flags, refusals, tests (the generators of ADR-0125; - — none; ADR-0126 addendum (2));
# depends — the n of former stages, comma-separated, - — none; when — CEL over the keys of the profile, empty — always applicable.
